Hidden-species view of a mixture: one species' cells, only its genes.

Source: R/validate_species.R
species_mix_hidden.Rd

The estimator sees no cross-species genes, so it must work as on ordinary single-species data. Truth is rescaled to what is estimable from these genes: contamination among the kept genes' counts, rho_hidden = rho_true * s_own * T / own.

Usage

species_mix_hidden(cells, empties, species, keep_species = NULL, truth = NULL)

Arguments

cells, empties, species

as for species_mix_truth().

keep_species

which genome to keep (default: the majority genome).

truth

optional precomputed species_mix_truth() result.

Value

list(cells, empties, rho_true, barcodes).
